page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c4.xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by the Intel Xeon E5-2667 v4 processor. Operating on the x86_64 architecture, this instance provides 4 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core running at a clock speed of 3.2 GHz. It features 8.0 GB of RAM, resulting in a 2.0 GB per core allocation, and does not include local storage or GPU hardware. Network performance is anchored by a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps under a KVM hypervisor.

In benchmark evaluations, the instance demonstrates modest performance characteristics. Single-core and multi-core CPU performance in stress-ng and Geekbench tests fall into the bottom 25% tier. Memory bandwidth tests show a similar trend, with uncached large-block read operations ranking in the bottom 10% and write operations in the bottom 25%. However, the processor achieves average performance in single-threaded gzip compression and bzip3 decompression, alongside average text generation speeds for small 135M parameter language models.

Given its hardware profile and benchmark results, the ecs.c4.xlarge offers an entry-level compute-focused option. The lack of bundled local storage and lower memory-to-vCPU ratio represents a tradeoff for memory-intensive or storage-heavy applications. It is best suited for lightweight compute tasks, basic web serving, single-threaded compression utilities, and small-scale development or testing workloads that do not require high-speed memory throughput.
